consequence.statement: Existing ImageUpdateAutomation resources continue to work; the v1 API version provides an additional stable endpoint for new or migrated resources.

original.statement: A new stable API version v1 is now served for the ImageUpdateAutomation custom resource kind.

decision.reason: Comparing the v2.6.4 install bundle [ev-782bc47d120d] with the v2.7.0 bundle [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], the deterministic crd and restatement validators confirm that image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 ImageUpdateAutomation exists only in the target release, so this is purely an added version. The canonical validator also confirms that the added/none rule applies: adding a subject has no consequence for existing environments. So "none" (informational) is the right kind. No evidence shows anything failing, being rejected or needing migration because of this addition. Whether an older version was removed would be a separate change, not part of this one.
